nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: A moving average approach was used to obtain unbiased mean and variance estimates for the GFA metric in each age range, from which Z-scores were derived.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: A moving average approach was used to obtain the unbiased mean and variance estimates for the GFA metric in each age range. Next, GFA was transformed into Z-scores, yielding individualized tract-alteration profiles.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and Sex were used as explanatory variables in the normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Sex-specific WM tract normative development was modeled from diffusion spectrum imaging of 626 typically developing controls (5-40 years)... This model established the normative ranges of variations in GFA, represented as functions of age and sex.
